title: Round 3, the last check before voicing every line (B-45): the corrected and risky words in their real pack lines, one sample of each tone, the two flagship narrators, and two friends' own voices next to the borrowed narrator.
note: Written by the voice-and-sound-director on 2026-11-01. Texts are the approved voice_text of the pack (line clips) or, where the pack has no voice_text yet (the sum with שָׁוֶה, the times sentence, the bottle lines with a land name), the exact sentence written here. Model eleven_v4_turbo, as content/voices.json; four clips repeat on eleven_v4 for the model A/B. Style and speed are not sent on any v4 model, so a line's tone here is its stability alone: ask 0.60, hint 0.65, hint 3 0.70, calm try-again 0.60, praise and bottle 0.50, thinking 0.55, celebration 0.35, ceremony 0.45; the two 0.10 clips are today's cheer, to compare. Similarity 0.8 for all.

clips.tests: אוּפְּס said 'UPS' (not 'ofs'); האוזניים said 'ha-oz-NA-yim'; kind and curious, the question rises. Tone: a calm 'say it again'.
תגידו לי said 'ta-gi-DU li' (not 'im-RU li'); a warm invitation.
נְגַלֶּה said 'ne-ga-LE' (we will find out), not 'nig-LE'; a thinking, curious tone.
שָׂמִים said 'sa-MIM' (we put); a clear instruction, not a scold.
בַּתּוֹר said 'ba-TOR' (in the queue), not 'be-TOR' (as); a real question: the pitch rises at the end.
Hint 1: very short, slow and soft, an invitation to listen again; no sigh, no scold.
Hint 2: a little more help, calm; 'ba-TOR' again; 'ri-SHON' clear.
Hint 3: shows the answer; the slowest and steadiest; a short beat at the dash before 'ללחוץ עליו'; ends warm.
בַּשָּׁמַיִם said 'ba-sha-MA-yim' (in the sky), stress on MA; בצהריים clear; a beat at the dash.
Praise: אֵלֶּה said 'E-le' (these), not 'e-LA'; חֲמִשָּׁה 'cha-mi-SHA'; glad, not shouting.
צדקתם said 'tz'dak-TEM' (you were right), not 'tza-dak-TEM'; praise that is glad and short.
A calm 'try again' after a mistake: curious and kind, never a scold; בַּתּוֹר 'ba-TOR'.
תיבה said 'tei-VA' (a box shape) and קופסה 'kuf-SA' (a shoebox): two different words; a beat at the dash.
קובייה said 'ku-BI-ya' (cube), stress on BI; a short question with a rising end.
בקובייה 'ba-ku-BI-ya' against ולתיבה 've-la-tei-VA'; מלבן 'mal-BEN'; a calm 'try again' with a reason, never a lecture.
A teen number: שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה 'shesh es-RE' (sixteen, feminine, for birds); a steady, clear number; praise tone.
= read from the plain word שווה: 'sha-VE' (equals) or 'SHA-ve'? The numbers shesh, shtayim, shmone clear.
clips.note: plain שווה is what the pack sends today (voices.json pronunciation is empty). If it is wrong, N18 is the fix: a pronunciation entry שווה = שָׁוֶה.
